{{Top|leg}}
A '''Weapon sling''' was any type of strap, made from a variety of materials, designed to allow for easy handling of long arms such as blaster rifles and slugthrower rifles. Coming in a dizzying array of styles, slings ranged from simple single-strap slings, to elaborate multi-strap slings made of specialized materials that allowed for a number of configurations. Slings typically cost a hundred credits, and notable models included the [[Custom-tooled Bantha hide sling]], [[Tactical three-point sling]], and [[Quick-release one-point drop sling]].<ref name="EOTE CR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
